note: City of Powers Lake short-term RV park on a gravel loop along the lakeshore at the south edge of town; the pads face the lake across the loop road. About 12 RV sites; the city also runs a separate long-term (monthly) RV park along the lake. Toilets, boat ramp and dock; walleye fishing. --Claude
summary: City Parks & Recreation page: a short-term RV park and a long-term RV park along the lake; only long-term monthly rates posted ($600/mo 50 A, $500/mo 30 A); call the city contact (701-705-5369, = stored phone) to check availability. No nightly rate, season, site count or short-term amperage. Lakeview stands as the ceiling (loop road between pads and shore). Pin ok. Leads: Lone Tree Campground and Smishek Lake Campground.
flags: LONG-STAY / WORDING: the city's only campground text is 'The City of Powers Lake has a short-term rv park as well as a long-term rv park located along the lake. 50 amp spots are $600/month and 30 amp spots are $500/month for the long term rv park. Please contact [name] to check the availability of spots - 701-705-5369.' No nightly rate is posted anywhere I could read (ndtourism 403). The 'check the availability' line sits after the long-term rates; I read it as a call-ahead for both, not as the 'call to see if we have room' discouragement, since the city names a separate short-term park - but the reviewer may weigh it. Share of nightly sites unknown from the city page (HHS list: 'POWERS LAKE RV PARK, 200 Lakeside Ave E, City of Powers Lake, 16' units, plus 'LAKE PARK CAMPGROUND, Lakeside E Ave, Powers Lake City Park Fund, 6').
FEES: no nightly rate on the city page; only the long-term monthly rates. Nothing written.

HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived) - the city page gives 50 A and 30 A only for the LONG-TERM park; short-term amperage unstated. Left alone, unconfirmed. Showers/dump (derived) not mentioned by the city; left alone.

WATERFRONT: lakeview stands, as the ceiling. The short-term loop (gravel, planted centre island) at ~48.5590,-102.6430: back-in pads along the island's south edge face the lake, ~25 m from the waterline, but the campground's own loop road and a shrubby bank lie between (loop road blocks on-water under the curation rules). No upgrade.
PIN: stored 48.55915,-102.64421 sits at the west end of the lakeside loop: ok.
